counting_policy: Count only unique rows that pass provenance, license, schema, quality, contamination and deduplication gates. Candidate and rejected rows never count toward the admitted target.

sources.known_lineage: Augmented from GSM8K and MATH training sets; source card states that test sets were not used.
required_checks: pin immutable source revision and verify license file at that revision
deduplicate against existing Drosophila shards and all declared upstream sources
audit source/type distribution and repeated templates
validate answer/solution completeness and mathematical consistency on a stratified sample
exclude any overlap with local holdouts

sources.known_lineage: Dataset card reports source aggregation including GSM8K, MATH, olympiad, forum, translated and synthetic subsets.
required_checks: resolve license discrepancy against an immutable upstream revision and all source materials
inspect source breakdown and identify duplicate/overlapping source datasets
train split only; never import test split
audit OCR, translation, synthetic subsets and mathematical correctness
exclude any overlap with local holdouts

sources.known_lineage: MetaMathQA declares GSM8K training data among its augmentation sources.
required_checks: use only train split for any future ingestion
compare exact and semantic overlap with MetaMathQA before counting
keep test split outside all training and curation outputs
